groupings.title: Learn and choose
groupings.description: Explain the LLM-Wiki pattern, answer evidence-backed adoption questions, track current ecosystem changes, map PAF Nexus/Cortex adoption, and help users choose a ready-made or custom solution.

groupings.title: Technology landscape
groupings.description: Map concrete implementations, implementation archetypes, retrieval stacks, ingestion tools, MCP/API integration, and evaluation/security tooling for LLM-Wiki systems.

groupings.title: Diagnose, plan, and evaluate
groupings.description: Inspect existing vaults, plan migrations, evaluate usefulness, audit criticism risk, benchmark pilots, and repair trust-critical gaps before large changes.

groupings.title: Implement and migrate
groupings.description: Set up, customize, and migrate documents into local-first or team LLM-Wiki systems.

groupings.title: Capture and domain workflows
groupings.description: Map company information flows, build capture pipelines, interview users for tacit knowledge, maintain decision memory, and generate domain-specific wiki packs.

groupings.title: Operate and trust
groupings.description: Run triage, ingest, query, lint, trust-audit, source-refresh, privacy, threat-model, security, model-policy, archive, and publishing workflows.

groupings.title: Skill and memory governance
groupings.description: Review, compile, and govern Agent Skills and decide what belongs in skills, agent memory, instruction files, or the wiki.
